note: CMYK values are simple estimates without a colour profile. Match blue and green to the logo on a printed proof.

colours.name: MPD Blue
colours.use: Primary. The logo letters and emblem, headings, the logo side of the card.

colours.name: Deep Blue
colours.use: Dark end of gradients, footer bands, QR squares on light grounds.

colours.name: Bright Blue
colours.use: Light end of gradients and highlights.

colours.name: Ink Blue
colours.use: Darkest blue: QR codes, small text on light grounds.

colours.name: MPD Green
colours.use: Accent. The diamond in the emblem, rules and small markers.

colours.name: Leaf Green
colours.use: Green for text (job titles, labels) - passes contrast on white.

colours.name: Lime Green
colours.use: Green on blue backgrounds (tagline on the blue card side).

colours.name: Pearl
colours.use: Warm off-white background for light surfaces.
